global_events: Seventeen current official August 2026 records were decided; fourteen selected and three fail-closed.
Savills and Auction House UK official sources were retained in this batch.
One Savills catalogue-plus-full-detail, ten Savills current catalogue snapshots and three Auction House full-direct source upgrades were retained.
All retained candidates have future 10–18 August 2026 auction dates relative to 31 July 2026.
Seventeen representative exact-address repository searches returned zero indexed hits; exhaustive duplicate proof is not claimed.
49 Park View was excluded because the current catalogue shows £105,000 while the current detail page exposes Guide price TBA.
902 Northampton House was excluded because full-detail retrieval resolved to prior-event pages rather than a current-event page.
89 Castleview House was excluded because its current full-detail page cache-missed and prior-event state was not reused.
Savills catalogue-only candidates were not expanded beyond the current 18 August official catalogue.
209 Manor Road and the three Auction House candidates had readable current full-detail evidence.
Guide prices and ranges are auction indications, not valuations or achieved prices.
Publisher rent, tenancy, yield and investment wording was not independently underwritten.
Lease, title, new-lease-on-completion, charges, balcony, lift, parking, garage and common-part obligations remain legal-pack dependent.
Extension, converted-garage and converted-building wording was not converted into planning or lawful-use outcomes.
Modernisation, refurbishment, measurements, services and condition wording requires professional inspection.
Vacancy, possession and occupational status require legal-pack confirmation.
Approximate areas were not independently surveyed.
Prior-event detail was not used to infer current guide, tenure or occupancy where current-event detail was unavailable.
Three records with current-detail ambiguity or cache miss were excluded rather than expanded.
No second runner, owner or task was created; continuation key was preserved.
Research was split across four bounded candidate groups while GitHub writes remained serial.
Wave, progress, web, report, validation and state files require final publication readback.
Automation 167 port-8012 DOM proof remains external and unresolved.
Public-host, parcel, geometry and final promotion remain blocked; no synthetic evidence was created.
